model_comparison_NEC.bic_formula: n*log(SSE/n) + k*log(n); k = 3 (broken-stick: b0,b1,c), 2 (linear), 3 (quadratic), 4 (natural cubic spline, 3 df + intercept; knots 0,6,12,18)
model_comparison_NEC.caveat: The 19 landmark points are overlapping-window estimates from the same patients and are strongly autocorrelated; SSE/BIC are descriptive, not likelihood-valid inference.
